summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories like Hugging Face, which hosts over 3 million public models as of August 2026, and developer-facing inference platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow that make running open-weight models accessible via local tools or serverless APIs. Download activity is highly concentrated—roughly half of Hugging Face models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads. These hubs and APIs are distinct from enterprise aggregators (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) and MLOps platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI), focusing instead on open models and fast developer access.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demo apps (Spaces), plus hosted inference and training tooling.
platforms.model_count: Over 3 million public models (surpassed 3M in August 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free for public hosting and community use; Pro ~$9/mo; Inference Endpoints and serverless inference billed by compute/usage; Enterprise/Team plans available
features: Largest open model and dataset catalog
Transformers, Diffusers, and other open-source libraries
Spaces for hosting demos and apps
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Model/dataset cards, versioning, and download stats
AutoTrain and fine-tuning tooling
platforms.best_for: Researchers, ML engineers, and developers needing the widest selection of open models, datasets, and collaboration tools

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local-first tool for downloading and running open-weight LLMs on your own machine with a simple CLI and API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models/variants (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi) in its library
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; no usage fees (you provide the hardware)
features: One-command local model download and run
Quantized GGUF models optimized for consumer hardware
Local REST API and OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Modelfile customization for prompts/parameters
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Runs offline for privacy-sensitive workloads
platforms.best_for: Developers and hobbyists wanting private, offline, local inference without cloud costs

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform to run and deploy open models (including image, video, audio, and LLMs) via simple API calls, packaged as 'Cog' containers.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models across modalities
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use, billed per second of GPU/compute time; no subscription required
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Strong support for image/video/audio generation (e.g., diffusion models)
Automatic scaling and cold-start handling
Fine-tuning for select models
Versioned model deployments
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting to quickly integrate or deploy multimodal open models without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A fast serverless inference and fine-tuning platform for open-source LLMs and multimodal models, plus dedicated GPU clusters for training.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Mixtral, Qwen, DeepSeek, FLUX, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference; per-hour GPU pricing for dedicated endpoints and training clusters
features: High-performance serverless inference with OpenAI-compatible API
Fine-tuning and LoRA training
Dedicated GPU clusters for large-scale training
Broad catalog of chat, code, embedding, and image models
Low-latency optimized inference stack
Batch inference support
platforms.best_for: Startups and developers needing scalable, cost-efficient inference and fine-tuning for open models

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A production-grade, high-speed inference platform for open and fine-tuned LLMs and multimodal models, optimized for low latency and throughput.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models plus custom/fine-tuned model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless; on-demand per-GPU-hour for dedicated deployments; enterprise plans available
features: Optimized FireAttention inference engine for speed
OpenAI-compatible API
LoRA and full fine-tuning with fast deployment
Function calling and JSON/structured output modes
Multimodal and vision model support
Dedicated and reserved GPU capacity for production
platforms.best_for: Teams building latency-sensitive, high-throughput production applications on open models

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer-focused serverless inference platform offering fast, affordable access to a wide range of open-source LLMs and multimodal models, popular in Asian markets.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, FLUX, GLM, and others)
platforms.pricing: Competitive pay-per-token pricing with generous free tiers for many models
features: OpenAI-compatible serverless API
Strong support for Chinese open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM)
Text, image, audio, and embedding models
Low-cost inference and free tiers for select models
Fast deployment and scaling
Fine-tuning support for select models
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) seeking low-cost access to leading open Chinese and global models

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform running open models on custom LPU hardware for extremely fast token generation.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of open models (Llama, Mixtral, Gemma, Qwen, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, with pricing competitive for high-speed inference; free developer tier available
features: Custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware
Industry-leading tokens-per-second throughput
OpenAI-compatible API
Low-latency streaming responses
Focus on popular open chat and reasoning models
platforms.best_for: Developers needing the fastest possible real-time inference for open models

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many open and proprietary model providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated from dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passed through from providers, with unified billing; some free models available
features: Single API for many providers and models
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
OpenAI-compatible interface
Transparent per-model pricing comparison
Access to both open-weight and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, multi-provider access and easy model switching without multiple integrations
